title: Waiting
full_review:
"Waiting" (Lions Gate) is a crass comedy about the sophomoric antics of a motley wait staff at a chain restaurant -- including a smug slacker (Ryan Reynolds), his roommate (Justin Long) and his ex-girlfriend (Anna Faris) -- during a single hectic dinner shift.

Writer-director Rob McKittrick serves up an unappetizing and unfunny menu of trashy sex jokes and gross sight gags.

The film contains pervasive vulgar humor, some sexual situations, partial frontal nudity, drug content involving minors, excessive rough and crude language, and profanity. The USCCB Office for Film & Broadcasting classification is O -- morally offensive. The Motion Picture Association of America rating is R -- restricted.
